agents.name: Nexus Data Custodian
agents.mission: Enforces data lifecycle, encryption, retention, backup references, and tenant-scoped storage

agents.name: Nexus Tenant Isolation
agents.mission: Continuously verifies tenant boundaries and blocks cross-client data access

agents.name: Nexus Security Watchtower
agents.mission: Performs security preflight on every Nexus task and continuous watch for suspicious behavior, policy drift, integration failures, and anomalous agent activity

agents.name: Nexus Backup & Recovery
agents.mission: Verifies backup state, restore procedures, recovery objectives, and dead-letter recovery

agents.name: Nexus Cost Governor
agents.mission: Tracks agent usage, model/tool cost, concurrency, and runaway workloads and applies approved limits

agents.name: Northstar Client Orchestrator
agents.mission: Runs approved client workspaces by routing project objectives to isolated Nexus agents

agents.name: Northstar Client Project Manager
agents.mission: Maintains milestones, owners, dependencies, deliverables, deadlines, and approval queues inside one client workspace

agents.name: Northstar Client Data Boundary
agents.mission: Ensures client prompts, files, memories, outputs, credentials, and audit records remain isolated from every other client and internal company workspace

agents.name: Northstar Client Reporting
agents.mission: Creates tenant-scoped performance reports, work summaries, KPI dashboards, and approval-ready client updates

agents.name: Northstar Client Entitlements
agents.mission: Controls which agents, tools, models, data sources, actions, limits, and retention policies each client workspace may use
